meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证并规划本地基因组间隔工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理基因组数据并需要验证BED文件
copy.tagline_en: Validate and plan local genomic-interval workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic data and need to validate BED files

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你用 geniml 处理基因组区间(BED)数据:训练区域嵌入、构建共识峰、分析单细胞 ATAC 数据,并提供相应代码示例和命令行用法。
howto.when: 当你提到 BED 文件、区域嵌入、scATAC-seq 分析等基因组机器学习任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 geniml 对这批 BED 文件训练 Region2Vec 嵌入。
say.note: Claude 会给出安装和运行步骤。

say.text: 如何用 scEmbed 分析我的单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据?
say.note: Claude 会说明预处理和训练流程。

say.text: 用 universe build 从这些 BED 文件构建共识峰。
say.note: Claude 会指导命令行操作。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to guide you through geniml, a Python package for ML on genomic intervals (BED files). Covers Region2Vec, BEDspace, scEmbed, consensus peak building, and utilities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work on genomic interval data (BED files) for ML, such as region embeddings, single-cell ATAC-seq analysis, or building consensus peaks.

say_en.text: Help me train Region2Vec embeddings on these BED files.
say_en.note: Claude will provide steps for tokenization and training.

say_en.text: How do I use scEmbed for my scATAC-seq data?
say_en.note: Claude will explain preprocessing and training.

say_en.text: Build a consensus universe from these BED files.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the command-line workflow.
